" alt=""></span>
      </div>
      <div class="home-character-hook"><b>8 種旅行動物</b>等你解鎖</div>
    </div>

    <div class="mode-cards-v9">
      <button class="mode-card-v9 match" onclick="startGame()"><span class="mode-icon">✦</span><span><b>幫我 Match</b><small>8 題 · 旅行動物人格＋目的地</small></span><em>→</em></button>
      <button class="mode-card-v9 fate" onclick="startFate()"><span class="mode-icon">🎲</span><span><b>直接交俾命運</b><small>4 題基本條件 · 約 20 秒即抽</small></span><em>→</em></button>
    </div>

    <div class="home-footer-v9"><span>唔使登入</span><i>•</i><span>以香港出發為基準</span><i>•</i><strong>人生得一次，飛啦喂！</strong></div>
  </section>

  <section id="question" class="screen">
    <div class="ambient a3"></div><div class="flight-path" style="top:135px"></div>
    <div class="topbar"><button class="back" onclick="prevQuestion()" aria-label="上一頁">←</button><div class="brand">飛啦喂！<small id="questionModeLabel">旅行小測驗</small></div><div class="stepnum" id="stepnum">1 / 8</div></div>
    <div class="progress"><i id="progressbar" style="width:12.5%"></i></div>
    <div class="question-head"><div class="kicker" id="questionKicker"></div><h2 class="title" id="questionTitle"></h2><p class="subtitle" id="questionSub"></p></div>
    <div class="guide-row"><div class="travel-tip-mark">✦</div><div class="guide-bubble" id="alienBubble">撳最似你今次旅行狀態嗰個答案就得。</div></div>
    <div class="question-card"><div class="choices" id="choices"></div></div>
    <div class="encourage" id="encourage"></div>
  </section>

  <section id="boxes" class="screen">
    <div class="ambient a1" style="top:330px"></div><div class="flight-path"></div>
    <div class="topbar"><button class="back" onclick="backToLastQuestion()" aria-label="上一頁">←</button><div class="brand">飛啦喂！<small>揀旅行盲盒</small></div><div class="stepnum">分析完成 ✓</div></div>
    <div class="box-intro"><div class="kicker">你嘅旅行 vibe 已經準備好</div><h2 class="title">揀一個<span class="hot">旅行盲盒</span></h2><p class="subtitle">我會標出最啱你嘅一盒。想反骨都得，其他盒一樣可以開。</p></div>
    <div class="recommend" id="recommendBox"></div>
    <div class="box-section-title">仲有其他旅程等你開</div><div class="box-grid" id="boxGrid"></div>
  </section>

  <section id="openbox" class="screen">
    <div class="kicker">你揀咗</div><h2 class="open-title" id="chosenBoxName"></h2><p class="open-sub">目的地已經放入盒。準備好就撳開。</p>
    <div class="mystery-stage" id="mysteryStage"><div class="glow"></div><div class="mystery-box" id="mysteryBox"><div class="light-beam"></div><div class="mini-pass"></div><div class="mb-base"></div><div class="mb-strip"></div><div class="mb-lid"></div><div class="mb-mark">?</div></div><i class="particle p1" style="--dx:-65px;--dy:-90px"></i><i class="particle p2" style="--dx:65px;--dy:-100px"></i><i class="particle p3" style="--dx:-35px;--dy:-105px"></i><i class="particle p4" style="--dx:45px;--dy:-115px"></i><i class="particle p5" style="--dx:-80px;--dy:-45px"></i><i class="particle p6" style="--dx:80px;--dy:-55px"></i></div>
    <button class="cta" id="openBtn" style="width:100%" onclick="openMystery()">開！</button><button class="ghost" id="openBackBtn" style="width:100%;margin-top:10px" onclick="returnFromOpen()">我想揀過另一盒</button>
  </section>

  <section id="analysis" class="screen">
    <div class="analysis-orbit route-loader"><div class="route-pass"><b>HKG</b><span>···· ✈︎ ····</span><b>???</b></div><div class="scan-line"></div></div>
    <div class="kicker">地球旅人資料分析中</div><h2 class="title" id="analysisText" style="text-align:center;font-size:30px">掃描旅行 vibe…</h2><p class="subtitle" id="analysisSub" style="text-align:center;max-width:330px">等我一次過幫你配對旅行人格同下一站。</p><div class="analysis-dots"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
  </section>

  <section id="result" class="screen">
    <div class="topbar"><button class="back" id="resultBack" onclick="resultBack()" aria-label="上一頁">←</button><div class="brand">飛啦喂！<small>YOUR NEXT STOP</small></div><div class="stamp" style="color:var(--blue)">MATCH<br>FOUND</div></div>
    <div class="result-hero">
      <div class="result-confetti"><i style="left:5%;top:2%;background:#FFC94A"></i><i style="left:20%;top:0;background:#79C8B2"></i><i style="left:36%;top:4%;background:#F45B69"></i><i style="left:58%;top:1%;background:#1677D2"></i><i style="left:76%;top:5%;background:#8B78C9"></i><i style="left:92%;top:1%;background:#FFC94A"></i></div>
      <div class="pre">開盒結果出爐！</div>
      <div class="result-combo" id="resultCombo"><div class="result-persona-art" id="resultAnimal"></div><div class="result-persona-copy"><small id="resultPersonaLabel">你今次嘅旅行人格</small><b id="resultPersonaName"></b><span class="persona-signature" id="resultPersonaSignature"></span></div></div>
      <div class="result-city-wrap"><div class="result-city-label">而你今次最啱飛去——</div><div class="result-city" id="resultCity"></div><div class="result-sub" id="resultCountry"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="postcard"><div class="scene"><div class="sun"></div><div class="buildings"></div><div class="tower"></div><div class="scene-label" id="sceneLabel"></div><div class="post-stamp">TRAVEL<br>SURPRISE<br>✈︎</div></div><div class="boarding"><div><small>FROM</small><strong>HKG</strong></div><div class="mid">✈︎</div><div style="text-align:right"><small>TO</small><strong id="resultCode"></strong></div></div></div>
    <div class="tags" id="resultTags"></div><div class="why"><h3>點解會啱你？</h3><div id="reasons"></div></div>
    <div class="result-actions"><button class="cta" onclick="go('share')">整張分享卡</button><button class="ghost" id="resultAgain" onclick="resultAgain()">再抽一次</button></div>
  </section>

  <section id="share" class="screen">
    <div class="topbar"><button class="back" onclick="go('result')" aria-label="上一頁">←</button><div class="brand">飛啦喂！<small>SHARE CARD</small></div><div class="stepnum">分享</div></div>
    <div class="kicker" style="margin-top:8px">IG Story / Facebook 分享卡預覽</div><h2 class="title" id="shareTitle" style="font-size:28px">畀朋友估下<span class="hot">佢又係咩動物</span></h2>
    <div class="share-preview"><div class="share-deco"></div><div class="share-inner"><div class="share-logo">飛啦喂！</div><div class="share-persona"><div class="mini-animal" id="shareAnimal"></div><div><small id="sharePersonaLabel">我原來係</small><b id="sharePersona"></b></div></div><div class="share-main"><small>今次旅行盲盒下一站——</small><h2><span id="shareCity"></span> ✈︎</h2></div><div class="share-ticket"><div class="route"><strong>HKG</strong><span>···· ✈︎ ····</span><strong id="shareCode"></strong></div><div class="share-vibe" id="shareVibe"></div></div><div class="share-cta"><div class="hook" id="shareHook">你又係邊種旅行動物？</div><b><span>下一站，</span>等你一齊抽 ✈️</b><p>入嚟飛啦喂！睇下下一個目的地去邊。</p><span class="share-pill">一齊抽下一站 →</span></div></div></div>
    <div class="share-buttons"><button onclick="nativeShare('IG Story')">IG Story</button><button onclick="nativeShare('Facebook')">Facebook</button><button onclick="nativeShare('WhatsApp')">WhatsApp</button></div><button class="ghost" style="margin-top:10px" onclick="restart()">再玩一次</button>
  </section>
</div>
